This negative trend contradicts the bullish narratives provided by other evidence such as E7 (P/B ratio) and E15 (3-year compounded sales growth). The stock's price-to-book value of 0.68x is also a red flag, further supporting the bear case against its current valuation, as evidenced by [E2]. Lastly, the PRICE-LED signal from scanX, indicating that price growth exceeds profit growth by 116%, suggests expectations are running ahead of delivery, which is not aligned with the bullish narrative provided in E54.
